description: Confirms the PBI's core data-integrity rule — GM Name is a single underlying field referenced in two display locations, preventing spelling inconsistencies. Uses invented test data: GM Name (EN) = "Ahmed Al-Kuwari", GM Designation (EN) = "Acting General Manager".

steps.expected: Values accepted.

steps.expected: Publish succeeds; success toast displays.

title: Verify that setting Status to Unpublish removes the page from the live site but keeps it editable
description: A Published page is transitioned to Unpublish.

steps.action: On a Published page, click Unpublish.
steps.expected: Success toast displays; Status changes to Unpublished.

steps.action: Check the live site and the CMS record.
steps.expected: Page no longer accessible to Visitors; record remains fully editable in CMS.

title: Verify that editing GM Name on an already-published page updates both the Portrait Caption and Signature Block only after republish
description: A GM's Message page is already Published with GM Name = "Ahmed Al-Kuwari". The Editor changes GM Name to "Khalid Al-Emadi" and republishes; verifies both display locations update identically and the change is not visible until republish completes.

steps.action: Confirm the currently Published page shows GM Name "Ahmed Al-Kuwari" in both the Portrait Caption and Signature Block.
steps.expected: Both locations show "Ahmed Al-Kuwari".

steps.action: In CMS, edit the GM Name field to "Khalid Al-Emadi" and click Save (without publishing yet).
steps.expected: Change is stored as a pending edit; the live page still shows "Ahmed Al-Kuwari" in both locations.

steps.action: Click Publish.
steps.expected: Publish succeeds.

steps.action: Reload the live page as a Public Visitor.
steps.expected: Portrait Caption and Signature Block both now show "Khalid Al-Emadi" — identical and updated together, with no location left showing the stale name.

title: Verify that a Site Content Author's field update to assigned GM's Message content is stored pending Editor publish
description: A Site Content Author updates the Page Content (EN) field on the GM's Message page and saves, per their view/update-assigned-content-only permission.

steps.action: As Site Content Author, edit Page Content (EN) and click Save.
steps.expected: Change is stored; no Publish control was available to the Author.

steps.action: As Site Content Editor, open the same record.
steps.expected: The Author's saved change is visible and available for the Editor to review and publish.

title: Verify that publishing is blocked when the Arabic title is missing while Arabic is enabled
description: All fields are complete except Page Title (AR), which is left empty; Arabic is enabled for the site. Admin attempts Publish.

steps.action: Complete all fields except Page Title (AR), leaving it blank, and click Publish.
steps.expected: "Arabic title is required." / "العنوان العربي مطلوب." error displays; publish is blocked.

title: Verify that an image exceeding 2MB is rejected with the exact stated message
description: Uploads a 2.3MB JPG as the Hero Banner and confirms the exact bilingual error message.

steps.action: Attempt to upload a 2.3MB .jpg file as Hero Banner (EN).
steps.expected: "Image size must not exceed 2 MB." / "يجب ألا يتجاوز حجم الصورة 2 ميغابايت." error displays; upload/save is blocked.
